mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix removes the closed-world definition of PermMatrix.Allowed. The injection grants ComplianceReviewer all write operations and Customer the GetAudit endpoint, directly violating LeastPrivilege, FR_004, FR_023, and FR_021.

Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the constraint that audit entries must match valid transition shapes. The injection forces an event with prevStatus=Approved (a terminal-status transition), which is a mutation of an already-decided state and violates AppendOnly and FR_016.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some e: ApplicationEvent | e.prevStatus = Approved and e.newStatus = Rejected }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OneInFlightPerCustomer removes the partial-unique-index analogue. The injection forces two distinct applications for the same customer both in Submitted status, exactly the concurrent-submission scenario FR-008 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OneInFlightViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.customer = a2.customer and a1.status = Submitted and a2.status = Submitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_DecisionByAssignedOfficer removes the constraint that decidedBy must equal assignedOfficer. The injection forces a Decision whose decidedBy is a different loan officer than the one assigned to the application, violating FR_013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DecisionByWrongOfficer { some d: Decision | some u: User | u.role = LoanOfficer and u != d.application.assignedOfficer and d.decidedBy = u }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditNoDuplicates removes the no-duplicate-transitions constraint. The injection forces two distinct ApplicationEvent atoms for the same application with identical prevStatus and newStatus, violating FR_019 and AppendOnly.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditEntry { some disj e1, e2: ApplicationEvent | e1.application = e2.application and e1.prevStatus = e2.prevStatus and e1.newStatus = e2.newStatus and no e1.prevStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CustomerOwnershipAccessReturnsNotFound removes the 404-not-404 existence-leak rule. The injection forces a customer operation on another customer's application to return Denied rather than NotFound, leaking the existence of the application.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ExistenceLeakViolation { some op: Operation | some op.caller and op.caller.role = Customer and op.kind = GetApplicationByRef and some op.targetApp and op.targetApp.customer != op.caller and op.outcome = Denied }
